upcoming.title: Live Music / TC King
upcoming.body: Enjoy an evening of live music, craft beer, cider, and great company as T.C. King sets the tone for a great Saturday night. His signature sound blends a plethora of genres with a soulful acoustic twist that will leave you craving more!

upcoming.title: Pints & Pegs - Cribbage
upcoming.body:
Join us for Cribbage Sundays! ❤️♠️

From seasoned pros to first-time players, this is a relaxed, community-style gathering where neighbors can connect over cards, conversation, and craft beer.

Here’s how it works:

• Bring your own board + cards if you have them (we’ll have a couple on hand to share).

• Play 2–3 games in a casual, drop-in format.

• Everyone who participates gets ½ off their first alcoholic drink — beer, cider, seltzer, or wine. 🍻

We’ll meet every other Sunday from 3–5 PM.

Must be 21+ to attend.

upcoming.title: Live Music / Jeremy Ross
upcoming.body: Jeremy plays an inviting mix of familiar songs that crowds can sing along with, and enjoy over a drink with friends. An easygoing acoustic set for breweries, tasting rooms, restaurants, private events, and community gatherings. The focus is simple: familiar favorites, a welcoming atmosphere, and music that feels like part of the evening.

past.title: Pints & Pegs - Cribbage Tournament
past.body:
Join us for Cribbage Sundays! ❤️♠️

From seasoned pros to first-time players, this is a relaxed, community-style gathering where neighbors can connect over cards, conversation, and craft beer.

Here’s how it works:

• Bring your own board + cards if you have them (we’ll have a couple on hand to share).

• Play 2–3 games in a casual, drop-in format.

• Everyone who participates gets ½ off their first alcoholic drink — beer, cider, seltzer, or wine. 🍻

We’ll meet every other Sunday from 3–5 PM.

Must be 21+ to attend.

past.title: Live Music / Cloudshine
past.body: Prepare to be captivated by the voice of an angel. LuAnna of CloudShine brings heartfelt melodies, radiant energy, and unmatched talent to the stage—leaving a trail of goosebumps and good vibes wherever she performs. Whether she’s strumming a soulful ballad or delivering a crowd favorite with her signature spark, LuAnna knows how to light up a room.
